_key.description: Genomic element key, Ensembl gene ID and source file accession joined by underscores.

enum: predicted regulatory element effect on gene expression

score.description: ENCODE-rE2G probability that the element has a regulatory effect on the target gene, from the DNase-only logistic regression classifier. Only links that pass the thresholded file's cutoff are loaded; that cutoff is set for 70% recall of CRISPR-validated links.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the ENCODE thresholded element-gene file this link was read from.

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the biosample the prediction was made in, taken from the first entry of the file's fileset simple_sample_summaries.
biological_context.example: head of caudate nucleus from ENCDO948PMW

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the biosample the prediction was made in, taken from the file's fileset metadata.

treatments_term_ids.description: Ontology term identifiers for the treatments applied to the samples, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when none were applied.

accessible_via.return: class, label, method, source, source_url, files_filesets, biological_context, biosample_term, score
